value.zh-Hant: 秘魯法學家、律師與政治人物，曾任聖馬科斯大學校長與眾議員。1932年起任外交部長兼內閣總理，1933年4月桑切斯·塞羅遇刺後以內閣首長身分暫攝最高權力。
value.en: Peruvian jurist, lawyer and politician, rector of San Marcos and a deputy. From 1932 he was foreign minister and head of cabinet, and after Sánchez Cerro's assassination in April 1933 he held supreme command as cabinet chief.
